source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
1. Check SUT configuration matches the specification/recipe.
2. Clear logs.
【During Test】
1. Power up the unit.
2. Log into BMC.
3. Enter BMC Advanced License if not yet done.
4. Open Power & Thermal > Power Settings.
5. Record Maximum Available Power, Peak Observed Power and Minimum Observed Power; select Enable Power Capping if not already enabled.
6. Set the cap at Maximum Available Power.
7. Click Apply.
8. Return to OS and run the stress tool for 30 hr.
【After Test】
Collect results/photos and check unexpected dmesg, syslog and SEL logs.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. CPU is capping the power utilization.
2. In the Power Meter page, the Average Power line should be below the Power Cap line. However, the Maximum Power line may cross above the Power Cap line.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED refuses execution until cap semantics, secure licensing, workload, monitoring and restore are defined.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 988/2291 kept PARTIAL under generic operator gating and did not resolve whether Maximum Available can exercise CPU capping.

historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 prohibits replacing write/stress coverage with a read; ED-36 does not treat ordinary inputs as permanent block, but the unresolved cap semantics prevent an objective test; ED-38 forbids automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Enable and set a CPU power cap, stress the system for 30 hours, and demonstrate that average power remains below the cap while preserving allowed maximum excursions.
original_method: Preserve the BMC-license/UI workflow and 30-hour stress requirement, but do not execute until the owner defines a cap that actually exercises CPU capping, exact scope/units, acceptance sampling, safe abort and restoration.
manual_activity: Engineer must define whether CPU package or chassis aggregate is capped, select an effective safe test value rather than assuming Maximum Available, resolve the duration discrepancy, and approve license entry, stress, abort and restoration.
required_inputs: Advanced-license entitlement and protected key process
safety_requirements: No license entry, cap write or stress in current form.
Never disclose license keys or credentials.
Do not guess Redfish URI or use insecure TLS.
Preserve pre-change cap and enable state before any approved run.
Abort on thermal, power, performance, OS or BMC anomaly.
No automatic retry; restoration failure is an incident.
agent_execution_scope: After correction and approval, capture original license/cap state and apply exactly one approved cap change.
Verify write/readback and run the bounded stress with independent watchdogs.
Restore original state and return evidence without verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve cap scope/value and duration conflicts.
Approve secure license, workload, acceptance, abort and recovery controls.
Own final verdict and failed-restoration escalation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not executable: guessed PATCH details omit schema and ETag/action semantics, read-only grep does not implement or prove the source workflow, and no license/stress/restore controls exist.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command until owner correction; then use the approved BMC UI or discovered vendor-supported API with protected secrets, typed units, write/readback and reversible restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Advanced License, UI locations, three watt values, Maximum Available selection, 30-hour text, 10/1440-minute metadata and Criteria remain preserved as conflicting source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve semantics, then run one interlocked cap-write/readback, bounded 30-hour stress, telemetry evaluation and restoration workflow.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the licensed Project BMC/SUT with vendor-defined cap control.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC, license tier, cap schema, UI and stress versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor cap-control specification and Project thermal/performance test plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a meaningful safe cap, protected licensing, objective time-series acceptance, watchdogs and mandatory restoration without reducing the 30-hour functional purpose.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A read-only PowerLimit query is partial evidence and cannot satisfy set/apply/stress coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative cap model, duration and full safety contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Persistent cap changes affect performance and long stress can expose thermal or availability faults.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved Redfish/vendor tool may replace UI manipulation only if license activation, cap enable/write/readback, stress observation and restoration coverage are shown equivalent; UI-specific coverage otherwise remains unverified.
expected_evidence: Engineer decisions for cap scope/value and duration
Protected license/target authorization and original cap state
Cap enable/write/readback with resource, units and timestamps
30-hour workload plus power/thermal/performance/health time series and abort audit
Restored cap/license-relevant state, post-health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Setting the cap to Maximum Available may not constrain power, yet Criteria require proof CPU is capping; the title says CPU while UI fields may be chassis-level, and 30 hours conflicts with Machine Time 1440 minutes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: These unresolved core semantics prevent selection of a meaningful stimulus and objective PASS rule; merely supplying Project credentials or packages cannot resolve them.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects PARTIAL execution because it would change global behavior without a testable cap contract.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Confirms BLOCKED and preserves its critical safety controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Overrides generic operator gating with an explicit semantic hold.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps this set operation separate from read-only inventory and later power-capping identities.

review_improvement: Prevents a long state-changing stress run that could trivially pass below a non-constraining maximum while leaving a persistent global cap.
independent_technical_reasoning: A cap at the platform's maximum available power commonly provides little or no throttling, so Average below that line cannot prove active CPU capping. Because the procedure also conflates CPU and chassis power and disagrees with its own duration metadata, an engineer must define the stimulus and acceptance before automation readiness can be assessed.
